items.name: ouro-base
items.title: Ouro base
items.description: Add it once per app, before your first component; no component installs it, so later adds never touch your stylesheet. What every Ouro UI component needs in the app's CSS: success and warning colors, a destructive foreground, the field border color (--input) and --radius when your theme has none, the motion tokens, the press utility, the keyframes for spinners, progress bars and skeletons, and --ouro-layer, the z-index of sheets and dialogs (50; raise it in a :root rule of your own if your app has fixed bars above z-50).
items.docs: Ouro UI's base tokens are in your CSS. Your theme's values win: a variable you already had keeps its value, and you edit the new ones like any shadcn variable. This add rewrote your stylesheet's spacing once (shadcn does that for any item with CSS); no component add touches it again. Docs: https://ui.ouroboros.bot/docs/installing.md Ouro UI v1.3.367.

items.name: ouro-testing
items.title: Ouro testing
items.description: Installed with every -tests item; you don't need to add it. The test kit Ouro UI's tests use: Vitest browser projects with the drag, flick, tap, doubleTap, touchDrag, touchStep, pointerPress, emulateMedia, pageZoom, resetPageZoom, setPageZoom and restoreTouch commands, the rotate helper (which turns the phone viewport and resets Chromium's zoom; the ouro-touch project fails a test that leaves the page zoomed), the act helper, the holdFrames helper (which holds animation frames and the clock still so a test steps a spring itself), the motion helpers (expectMotion, expectNoMotion, expectGestureSettle, expectTransition and parseDuration, which prove exactly which CSS properties a state change runs on each part), watchAnnouncements (which records what live regions announce, so a test proves a message is heard once per change), axeExclude, and the end-to-end story helper.

items.name: ouro-census
items.title: Ouro census
items.description: Optional: the census journey kit. A Playwright spec of yours lists the pages your app renders and the states a person can open on them; the census records the exact multiset of visible controls in each (role, name, Ouro marker, context) and fails on any change from the committed baseline, and on any unmarked control in a journey you enrol. Unmarked controls may only fall, state by state. It installs e2e/ouro-census/ (the spec helper, the merge, the baseline update and a comparison of two runs).
items.docs: The census kit is in e2e/ouro-census/. Call censusTests({ test, journeys, projects, componentsDir }) from a spec of yours, merge each run with node e2e/ouro-census/census-merge.mjs, and accept a change with node e2e/ouro-census/census-update.mjs <run-id | file>. items.description: Optional: the hand-rolled-control source rule. It reads your app's source with the TypeScript compiler and its stylesheets with PostCSS, and finds the controls still built by hand (a raw <button>, <a>, <input>, a click handler on a <div>, another UI library's control, control-state styling) and every component that wraps one, as fingerprints held to a committed baseline that may only shrink. It installs scripts/ouro-source-rules.mjs.
items.docs: The source rule is scripts/ouro-source-rules.mjs. Run node scripts/ouro-source-rules.mjs --write-baseline once to record where your app starts, then node scripts/ouro-source-rules.mjs in CI (with --base <ref> on pull requests). Docs: https://ui.ouroboros.bot/docs/guardrails.md Ouro UI v1.3.367.

items.name: ouro-check
items.title: Ouro check
items.description: Optional: the screen check. It opens every page of a built folder or a URL in headless Chromium at every screen size from 320 to 3840 wide, light and dark, and finds overlap, sideways scroll, clipped text, blurry pictures, pictures that fade into the page and serious axe-core violations, and long lines only where ouro-check.json declares a measure, and narrow text where a max-width holds prose well short of its column, each with a captioned close-up and a contact sheet per page. It measures layout shift while loading, the time to the first content and each press's time to paint, each against a budget, and records each number in its report. A run split with --shard k/n and joined with merge finds what one run does. Its fades.ts finds every gradient used as a mask in your source, and every wash laid over a picture, so no picture fades into the page. It installs scripts/ouro/check/.
items.docs: Ouro check is in scripts/ouro/check/, outside your TypeScript project, so tsc -b does not read its Node imports. Build your app, run node scripts/ouro/check/check.ts <built folder | URL> and fix what it reports. Its Node files import the shared Ouro AX files as #ouro-ax/<file>, so add that line to package.json once, with src/lib replaced by the folder your components.json lib alias points at: npm pkg set "imports.#ouro-ax/*=./src/lib/ouro/ax/*". Run node scripts/ouro/check/fades.ts src to find a picture that fades into the page in your source. To script a Mac or Windows app's first run from a fresh machine, import FirstRunSession and DETOURS from scripts/ouro/check/first-run.ts, and on Windows windowsSystem and buildWindowsEyes too; managedMac plays a managed Mac's SSO extension. Docs: https://ui.ouroboros.bot/docs/guardrails.md Ouro UI v1.3.367.

items.docs: Ouro images is in scripts/ouro/images/. Run node scripts/ouro/images/images.ts <folder of pictures> --out public/images --base /images/ and draw each picture from images.json. Its Node files import the shared Ouro AX files as #ouro-ax/<file>, so add that line to package.json once, with src/lib replaced by the folder your components.json lib alias points at: npm pkg set "imports.#ouro-ax/*=./src/lib/ouro/ax/*". Docs: https://ui.ouroboros.bot/docs/guardrails.md Ouro UI v1.3.367.

items.name: ouro-ax
items.title: Ouro AX
items.description: Ouro AX, the agent-experience kit, in one item: the ax-* items, from one command definition to the X-ray that checks an interface against the claims.
items.docs: Ouro AX is in lib/ouro/ax. Its Node-only files (the X-ray, the flow runner, the surfaces check and their tests) are in scripts/ouro/ax, outside your TypeScript project, so tsc -b does not read them. Its Node files import the shared Ouro AX files as #ouro-ax/<file>, so add that line to package.json once, with src/lib replaced by the folder your components.json lib alias points at: npm pkg set "imports.#ouro-ax/*=./src/lib/ouro/ax/*". It runs on Node 22.18 or later, which strips the types, and has no dependencies. Docs: https://ui.ouroboros.bot/docs/ax.md Ouro UI v1.3.367.
